clue.text: Making love on the royal yacht?

definitions.text: Making love on the royal yacht?

parts.words: Making love on the royal yacht?
parts.note: a romantic pursuit read literally as the vessel belonging to a royal court

explanation.surface: Someone wonders about romance aboard the Queen's yacht.
explanation.walkthrough: Wooing is the old sense of courting; split the word and a royal court's ship appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Wooing someone, the old sense of making love, is the romantic pursuit of a partner.

clue.text: TUC deeply afflicted

parts.note: the letters of this trade union body, written upwards in a down entry, read as a word meaning slice

explanation.surface: The trade unions are deeply distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: TUC is Britain's Trades Union Congress. Read the answer as an instruction: a slicing word written upwards, which in a down light gives TUC.
explanation.definitionFit: To be badly upset or distressed is an informal idiom for being deeply afflicted.

clue.text: True English can't form speech

indicators.note: to form here is to shape these letters into something new

explanation.surface: Proper English cannot be made into speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Something spoken aloud is an expression in words, a synonym for speech.

clue.text: Newspaper medium may turn on the heat

parts.note: The Times is a British national newspaper
a witch, like a spiritualist medium, deals with the supernatural

explanation.surface: A newspaper's psychic might warm things up.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes what the device does: a timer that switches on heating.
explanation.definitionFit: A timer-controlled switch is what may bring central heating on at a set hour.

clue.text: Border security can be deadly

definitions.note: a descriptive definition: the answer is a plant that can be deadly

parts.note: a hem is the border of a piece of cloth
a lock provides security

explanation.surface: Guarding a frontier can prove fatal.
explanation.definitionFit: The poisonous plant that killed Socrates is a byword for something that can kill.

clue.text: Love potion said to enhance purity

indicators.note: said signals that the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a filter removes impurities, so it serves to enhance purity

explanation.surface: A love drink is supposedly a way to make things purer.
explanation.definitionFit: A philtre is a magic drink meant to arouse love, a love potion.

clue.text: Identification mark of one from a set that's incomplete

indicators.note: something incomplete lacks its final part, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a badger lives in a sett, punningly spelt set here

explanation.surface: A token taken from an unfinished collection serves for identification.
explanation.walkthrough: A badger's burrow is a sett; the clue drops a T to make 'one from a set' look like a collection's item.
explanation.definitionFit: A badge worn on clothing is a mark showing who or what someone is.

clue.text: Jungle man could be subhuman — not half!

indicators.note: could be signals that the remaining letters may be rearranged
not half says half the word is not used, here its second half

explanation.surface: A forest dweller might seem less than human, absolutely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half!' drops the back half of SUBHUMAN, leaving SUBH; 'could be' rearranges it. 'man' is a link joining the parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Wild uncultivated land, especially in Africa or Australia, is called the bush, like jungle.

clue.text: Roger exhausted without being an idler

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: done in means exhausted
R stands for roger, the radio signal meaning received

explanation.surface: Roger, worn out, without being lazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A male bee does no work in the hive, so the word means a lazy person.

clue.text: What a gricer does to get it?

definitions.text: What a gricer does to get it?

parts.words: What a gricer does to get it?
parts.note: a gricer is a railway enthusiast who watches locomotives; the result of all that watching is a sore-eyed ailment

explanation.surface: A trainspotter's habit produces a complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: Gricer is British slang for a trainspotter; the answer splits into what one does to locomotives.
explanation.definitionFit: Visual fatigue comes from overusing the eyes, as a gricer staring at locomotives might.

clue.text: Object of veneration encountered Old Testament rejection

indicators.note: rejection turns these pieces back, read from right to left

parts.note: met means encountered

explanation.surface: A revered object met with dismissal from the Old Testament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejection' turns METOT to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved emblem revered by a clan is an object of veneration.

clue.text: In Kent it's made no difference…

definitions.note: a place in Kent, its county town

indicators.note: making a difference to the letters changes their order

parts.note: taken as its letters

explanation.surface: In Kent it didn't matter at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'difference' signals rearranging ITS and MADENO. Kent is a county in south-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: Maidstone is the county town of Kent, so it is a place in that county.

clue.text: … to new sport reporter on the south coast

indicators.note: a new version of the word has its letters rearranged

parts.note: a mouth is one who speaks out, a mouthpiece or reporter

explanation.surface: The ellipsis continues: no difference to a fresh sport journalist on the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges SPORT; it is one of England's south-coast naval cities.
explanation.definitionFit: Portsmouth is a naval port city located on England's southern coastline.

clue.text: A little cash is in the post, we're told

indicators.note: what we are told is heard, so this signals a sound-alike

parts.note: a letter in the post has been sent

explanation.surface: Some money is on its way by mail.
explanation.definitionFit: A cent is a coin worth one hundredth of a dollar, a small amount of money.

clue.text: What maintenance staff should do at points, etc

definitions.text: What maintenance staff should do at points, etc

parts.words: What maintenance staff should do at points, etc
parts.note: railway workers inspecting the track at junctions; the phrase is also the name of guard rails fitted there

explanation.surface: Advice about the work of engineers on the railway.
explanation.walkthrough: Points are railway switches; extra rails fitted there to keep wheels on track bear this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Guard rails beside the running rails at railway points, also read as inspecting the track.

clue.text: Silk net made into mastic

indicators.note: made into signals the letters becoming something else

explanation.surface: Silk netting turned into a resin.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastic tree, a Mediterranean shrub yielding resin, goes by this name.

clue.text: Support is overdue for what diets do

parts.note: a leg is a support, as of a table
late means overdue

explanation.surface: Being supportive is long overdue in what weight-loss plans achieve.
explanation.walkthrough: A diet here is a legislative assembly, like the Japanese Diet, not an eating plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A diet is a parliament or assembly, so what it does is make laws.

clue.text: Girl receives letter in Greek from spiny creature

indicators.note: one word receives the other inside it

parts.note: Edna is a girl's name
chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A girl gets a letter written in Greek from a prickly animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The spiny anteater of Australia and New Guinea is a spiny creature.

clue.text: Approve of European cutting out a drug

parts.note: to dig is slang for approve of

indicators.note: cutting out removes the named letter from the word

parts.note: an Italian is a European

explanation.surface: Endorse a European who removes a medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Digitalin is a heart drug extracted from foxglove leaves.

clue.text: Impish enjoyment soldier's taken in scene of massacre

indicators.note: one piece is taken in by the other, inside it

parts.note: glee is mischievous delight
an NCO is a non-commissioned officer, a soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier enjoys some mischief at the site of a slaughter.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1692 massacre of the MacDonalds took place in this Scottish glen.
explanation.definitionFit: The Highland glen was the scene of a notorious 1692 massacre of a clan.

clue.text: Tie lace loosened by Zeno, for example

indicators.note: loosened letters come apart and are put back differently

explanation.surface: Zeno undoes his shoelace.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeno of Elea was a philosopher of the school founded at Elea, an example of its members.

clue.text: Figure a month with endless pain

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: agony is intense pain

explanation.surface: A painful month seems to drag on.
explanation.definitionFit: A decagon is a ten-sided geometric figure.

clue.text: Pretentious type loses name, then he falls

indicators.note: loses takes the named word away

parts.note: a name-dropper pretentiously mentions famous acquaintances
taken as written

explanation.surface: A snob forgets a name and comes a cropper.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: something or someone that drops, lets drops fall.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that lets drops fall, such as an eye pipette, is literally one that falls them.

clue.text: Rifle fire

definitions.meaning: to rifle is to plunder or ransack a place
to fire someone is to dismiss them from a job

explanation.definitionFit: Plundering a captured town and dismissing an employee are both senses of the word.

clue.text: Many deserted following schism

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
left means deserted

explanation.surface: Many people walked out after a split.
explanation.definitionFit: A split or division, a schism, is a cleft.

clue.text: Free trade — comic sort of rule

definitions.note: the answer is an adjective describing a kind of rule or government

indicators.note: freeing the letters lets them form a new order

explanation.surface: Free trade sounds like a joke form of governance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Free' rearranges TRADE and COMIC; the definition is a sort of rule, government by the people.
explanation.definitionFit: Government by elected representatives of the people describes one sort of rule.

clue.text: Dedicated type much seen in church

definitions.meaning: the clergy, those dedicated to religion, are known collectively by this word
fabric such as altar linen is seen everywhere in churches

explanation.definitionFit: The clergy are called by this word, and fabric covers altars in church.

clue.text: Military order to avoid?

definitions.meaning: a drill command, short for attention

explanation.definitionFit: A clipped drill command for attention is spelt like the verb meaning keep away from.

clue.text: Pharaoh's approving expression on passionate record

definitions.note: the possessive is read as the contraction Pharaoh is, so the clue says the wordplay is a pharaoh, which keeps the definition a noun

parts.note: amen expresses agreement
hot means passionate
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: An Egyptian king's devout response to a steamy recording.
explanation.definitionFit: Amenhotep was the name of several ancient Egyptian kings.

clue.text: Doughboy rejected "bathroom" in northern accommodation

indicators.note: rejected turns the soldier's letters back

parts.note: a doughboy was a US infantryman, a GI
loo is British slang for a toilet

explanation.surface: An American soldier refused the facilities in Arctic lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: An Inuit snow house is a dwelling in the far north.

clue.text: Dined in college, it's said

indicators.note: what is said is heard, signalling a sound-alike

parts.note: Eton College is an English public school

explanation.surface: Someone had dinner at their old school.
explanation.walkthrough: ETON is England's famous boarding school, formally Eton College.
explanation.definitionFit: Having dined means having eaten a meal.

clue.text: Lines in church choir work curtailed by a bloomer

indicators.note: the lines go in the middle of the other pieces
curtailed means the end of the word is cut off

parts.note: an anthem is a work sung by a choir
RY is short for railway line, RYS for lines

explanation.surface: Lines in a church anthem cut short by a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: A bloomer is a flower, not a mistake. 'curtailed' cuts the tail EM from ANTHEM.
explanation.definitionFit: A chrysanthemum, shortened here, is a flowering plant, a bloomer.
